.ot-rot-id,.ot-rot-n{border-top: 2px solid #111;display: flex;align-items: center;justify-content: center;font-size: 13px;white-space: nowrap;overflow: hidden;font-family: Arial,sans-serif;}

.reg-ficha{background: #fff;border: 2px solid var(--sem-vino);border-radius: 14px;padding: 18px 22px;margin-bottom: 18px;display: grid;grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;gap: 8px 26px;align-items: start;}
.reg-link{background: none;border: none;color: var(--sem-vino);text-decoration: underline;cursor: pointer;font: inherit;padding: 0;}

.rot-hoja{background: #fff;width: 182mm;box-sizing: content-box;padding: 14mm;margin: 0 auto 20px;box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.12);display: flex;flex-direction: column;gap: 2.5mm;page: rotulos;}
